segments.text: PAMR shrinks links without storing them in a back-end database. Instead, it compresses the URL itself, stripping common patterns, matching domains
against Huffmancoded dictionaries, then packing the remainder into a compact character set. For QR codes, it switches to QR's alpha numeric mode to reduce
encoding overhead. Everything runs in the browser.
